name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: The angler who landed the Perch's weight is at least 4 lb more than Esther.
Grayreach goes with exactly two of Catfish, Jig, and 10 lb.
The angler at Mossbank's weight is exactly 4 lb more than the angler who landed the Bluegill.
Royce's weight is higher than both the angler at Grayreach and the angler using the Spoon.
Esther's weight is immediately next to the angler using the Spoon.
The angler who landed the Catfish's weight is exactly 4 lb more than the angler using the Spinnerbait.
Boone and Royce are in the same watershed.
